member.name: T:DlibDotNet.Extensions.GrayscalLumaCoefficients
member.summary: Define the standard for converting RGB values to luminance when gray-scaled.

member.name: F:DlibDotNet.Extensions.GrayscalLumaCoefficients.ITU_R_BT_601
member.summary: Operate gray-scaled by BT.601 of ITU-R (ITU Radiocommunication Sector) Recommendation. Luminance of formula is 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B.

member.name: F:DlibDotNet.Extensions.GrayscalLumaCoefficients.ITU_R_BT_709
member.summary: Operate gray-scaled by BT.709 of ITU-R (ITU Radiocommunication Sector) Recommendation. Luminance of formula is 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B.

member.name: F:DlibDotNet.Extensions.GrayscalLumaCoefficients.SMPTE_240M
member.summary: Operate gray-scaled by 240M specification SMPTER (Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers) established. Luminance of formula is 0.212 R + 0.701 G + 0.087 B.

member.name: F:DlibDotNet.Extensions.NativeMethods.NativeLibrary
member.summary: Native library file name. If Linux, it will be converted to libDlibDotNetNative.so If MacOSX, it will be converted to libDlibDotNetNative.dylib If Windows, it will be available after call LoadLibrary. And this file name must not contain period. If it does, CLR does not add extension (.dll) and CLR fails to load library
